shortBulletSummary: Hawkish Fed Chair Warsh's Jackson Hole speech sparked a crypto market pullback.
Bitcoin ETFs saw $202M in net outflows on August 28, ending a nine-day inflow streak.
XRP ETFs recorded their strongest weekly inflows of 2026, totaling $110M.
The Crypto Fear & Greed Index cooled from "Extreme Greed" to "Greed."
Solana (SOL) surged as Charles Schwab announced plans to add it to its crypto platform.
